anchors.description: Printed worksheet in a sleeve on the left wall; vertical short edge of the sheet, measured between the sheet's top edge and its bottom edge at x=30 px.
anchors.visible_evidence: A column of uniform white printed sheets with red/yellow borders hangs on the left wall; the nearest fully visible sheet spans about x 24-82 px and y 89-137 px (width/height ~1.21), consistent with a landscape 11 x 8.5 in leaf at only mild perspective. Both endpoints lie on that same sheet: p1 on its top edge, p2 on its bottom edge, a few pixels in from the left border.
anchors.identity_uncertainty: Size is inferred from the uniform printed-worksheet appearance; it could be a slightly oversized pre-printed chart. A4 (0.210 m) and US Letter (0.216 m) differ by only ~3%, so the vertical extent is insensitive to that choice, but an 11x17 enlargement would be ~29% larger.

anchors.description: Back-wall classroom whiteboard: vertical height from its top frame edge down to the bottom edge where the marker tray sits.
anchors.visible_evidence: Large white board with red/blue handwriting covering the back wall right of the pocket chart; its top frame runs just under the long red/blue banner and its bottom edge is the line where the marker tray holds pink, blue and red items. The visible width is at least 1.3x the height, consistent with a 4 x 8 ft board seen obliquely.
anchors.identity_uncertainty: Height is assumed from the common 4 ft (1.22 m) classroom whiteboard; a 5 ft board would be ~25 percent taller. The top frame edge is partly lost against the banner, and the far wall's absolute depth is not independently calibrated.
